card.name: Disease-risk words before a following term
card.fires_on: Words such as viruses, diseases, secondary and disease in warnings and dosing duration text, and partway through long drug or condition names like cholelithiasis, nifedipine and fenofibric.

modes.label: Infection and risk words
modes.description: Nouns or adjectives in warnings that are followed by a linking word or a condition name, such as infectious agents or secondary leukemia.
modes.example: Mitoxantrone therapy increases the risk of developing<< secondary>> leukemia in patients with cancer

modes.label: Until disease progression
modes.description: The word disease after 'until' in treatment-duration instructions.
modes.example: Treatment should continue until<< disease>> progression or unacceptable toxicity occurs.

modes.label: Inside long medical names
modes.description: Middle pieces of long drug or condition names.
modes.example: There is no specific treatment for overdose with fenof<<ib>>ric acid delayed-release capsules.

card.plain: It fires on disease and infection words in warnings and on the middle of long drug names, where a specific next word is expected.
